1.0.1: ChangeTaskTags, ChangeTaskWorkflowStage and CreateTaskComment send to the out port they declare; ChangeTaskTags outputs the tag ids under `tags`.
ChangeTaskAssignees accepts numeric user ids from flow variables and no longer duplicates existing assignees.
1.0.2: MakeApiCall sends the Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer (key-value input is the JSON string of an object).
1.0.3: Await context.sendJson in all action components so the output is sent before receive() resolves.
